name: Hyperprolactinemia

category.name: General Systemic
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating endocrinologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
Results of any other testing (e.g., labs or imaging) already performed.
Medical records from any visit associated with this condition.
If any concern for pituitary tumor, MRI pituitary must be submitted. See Pituitary Adenoma page for requirements.

rows.label: B
rows.condition: Due to any other cause (e.g., adrenal insufficiency, hypothyroidism, medication, chronic kidney disease, or tumor in any location other than pituitary)
